name: viz-spec
description: Formal models of the viz write/read protocol (Quint + TLC, and an explicit-state checker in TypeScript) and their checks

scripts.typecheck: quint typecheck viz.qnt && quint typecheck viz_test.qnt && tsc -p bfs
scripts.test:quint: quint test --backend typescript --max-samples 20 --main=fixed_test viz_test.qnt && quint test --backend typescript --max-samples 20 --main=literal_test viz_test.qnt
scripts.check:tlc: node experiments.mjs teeth literal witness fixed
scripts.check:quick: npm run typecheck && npm run test:quint && node --max-old-space-size=1024 bfs/run.ts teeth finding && node experiments.mjs teeth literal && node fill-readme.mjs --write
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:quint && npm run check:bfs && npm run check:tlc && npm run check:sim && node fill-readme.mjs --write
